title: Fiction-Publisher book configuration (config.yml)
description: Metadata and build settings for a Fiction-Publisher book project. Empty values are allowed (they are treated as not set).

seriesBook.description: A book to list on the series ("Also Available") page.

title-latex.description: LaTeX-formatted title for PDF output (overrides title).

subtitle-latex.description: LaTeX-formatted subtitle for PDF output (overrides subtitle).

link.description: Store link for the book (used in the Amazon ePub).

title-latex.description: LaTeX-formatted title (overrides title on the title and half-title pages of PDF output). A raggedrighttitle environment is available for multi-line titles.

title-page-top-margin.description: Space above the title on the title page (default is 4cm).

main-font.description: Main body font for PDF output (a TTF/OTF filename in Pandoc/fonts, or a font name). Default is Cochineal.

main-font-bold.description: Bold variant of main-font (a TTF/OTF filename in Pandoc/fonts, or a font name). Needed when main-font is a font file.

main-font-italic.description: Italic variant of main-font (a TTF/OTF filename in Pandoc/fonts, or a font name). Needed when main-font is a font file.

main-font-bold-italic.description: Bold italic variant of main-font (a TTF/OTF filename in Pandoc/fonts, or a font name). Needed when main-font is a font file.

title-font.description: Font for the book title on the title and half-title pages (a TTF/OTF filename in Pandoc/fonts, or a font name).

title-font-pointsize.description: Font size of the title in PDF output (default is 50).

subtitle-latex.description: LaTeX-formatted subtitle (overrides subtitle on the title page of PDF output).

author-font.description: Font for the author's name on the title page (a TTF/OTF filename in Pandoc/fonts, or a font name).

author-by-header.description: The "By" label above the author on the title page (default is blank).

text.description: A unique (version 4) UUID for your ebook.

cover-image.description: Path to the ePub cover image, relative to the book's folder (e.g., images/cover.jpg).

copyright-page.description: Copyright page template (from Pandoc/templates/copyright). Default is creative-commons.

contributors.description: People who contributed to the book.

cover-artist.description: Who created the art of your book cover.

illustrator.description: Who did the interior illustrations (appears on the title page).

rights.description: A single sentence regarding the licensing of your book.

paperback-isbn-13.description: Optional 13-digit ISBN of your paperback book.

hardcover-isbn-13.description: Optional 13-digit ISBN of your hardcover book.

epub-isbn-13.description: Optional 13-digit ISBN of your epub book.

paperback-isbn-10.description: Optional 10-digit ISBN of your paperback book.

hardcover-isbn-10.description: Optional 10-digit ISBN of your hardcover book.

epub-isbn-10.description: Optional 10-digit ISBN of your epub book.

first-paperback-date.description: Publication date of the first paperback edition.

lcc-info-latex.description: LaTeX-formatted Library of Congress Cataloging-in-Publication Data (PDF copyright page).

lcc-info-html.description: HTML-formatted Library of Congress Cataloging-in-Publication Data (ePub copyright page).

impression-line-years.description: Year part of the printer line (years run right-to-left, usually 2-digit).

impression-line-printings.description: Print-run part of the printer line (numbers run left-to-right).

toc.description: Whether to include a table of contents in the print output.

toc-title.description: Header text for the table of contents.

toc-depth.description: How many heading levels the print table of contents shows: 0 for chapters only, 1 to also show sections (headings marked with ##), and so on.

series-header.description: Header on the series page (default is "Also Available").

colophon.description: Whether to include a colophon page (typesetting information) in the print output.

paper-height.description: Paper height for print output (default paper size is 6x9 inches).

top-margin.description: Top margin in the print output (headers are inside the text body).

bottom-margin.description: Bottom margin in the print output.

inner-margin.description: Inner (gutter) margin in the print output.

outer-margin.description: Outer margin in the print output.

fancy-chapter.description: Chapter heading style from the fncychap package (PDF only). Overrides chapter-heading.

chapter-heading.description: Custom chapter heading theme (from Pandoc/templates/chapter-heading). Default is default.

chapter-name.description: The word used for "Chapter" in chapter headings, running headers, and the ePub labels of chapters with no title (e.g., Kapitel). Default is Chapter.

drop-cap-style.description: Drop cap style for the first letter of each chapter (PDF only).

scene-separator-latex.description: LaTeX code to replace *** between scenes (PDF output).

scene-separator-html.description: HTML code to replace *** between scenes (ePub output).

no-hyphenate-list.description: Space-separated list of words showing how they should be hyphenated (e.g., character names that shouldn't be split).

header-includes.description: Raw content to embed in the template's header (e.g., LaTeX commands).

unnumbered-chapters.description: Semicolon-separated list of chapter folder names (without the number prefix) that are unnumbered, such as a prologue. These aren't labeled or counted as numbered chapters. Default is Prologue; Epilogue.

emphasis-check.description: Semicolon-separated list of phrases that should be italicized (a warning is logged if they aren't).

copyedit.description: Outline the sections and show marginal notes in the print output (useful with CriticMarkup).

build-draft.description: false to not build a draft copy (default is true).

build-epub.description: false to not build an ePub file (default is true).

build-amazon-epub.description: false to not build the Amazon KDP ePub (default is true).

build-print.description: false to not build a PDF file (default is true).
